## Background

I completed my undergraduate studies in Statistics at the University of Ottawa. During my undergraduate studies, I developed a strong foundation in mathematics, statistics, and programming. These experiences made me interested in connecting theoretical knowledge with practical problems.

## Why Data Science

I chose the UBC Master of Data Science program because I want to strengthen my practical skills in data analysis and computing. I am especially interested in combining the mathematical and statistical theory I learned during my undergraduate studies with computer science tools and real-world applications. I also hope to explore new areas of data science and better understand how these skills are used in practice.

## Outside of Data Science

Outside of academics, I enjoy soccer, basketball, and esports. Sports and gaming are some of the main ways I relax in my free time. I also enjoy meeting new people, exploring new places, and learning from people with different backgrounds and experiences.
